action.action-desc: Mr. Arrington (for himself and Mr. Cuellar) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Ways and Means, and in addition to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned

form.official-title: To amend title XVIII of the Social Security Act to provide for coverage of rural emergency medical access services under the Medicare program, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Save Rural Communities Act of 2020.

section.header: Medicare rural emergency access centers and services

paragraph.header: Rural emergency access center and services defined
paragraph.text: Section 1861 of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395x) is amended—

subparagraph.text: in subsection (e), in the last sentence of the matter following paragraph (9), by inserting or a rural emergency access center (as defined in subsection (kkk)(1)) before the period at the end; and
by adding at the end the following subsection:

subsection.header: Rural Emergency Access Center; Rural Access Medical Center Services

paragraph.text: The term rural emergency access center means a facility that—

subparagraph.text: was, as of the date that is 2 years prior to the date of the enactment of this subsection—

clause.text: a hospital with not more than 50 beds located in a county (or equivalent unit of local government) in a rural area (as defined in section 1886(d)(2)(D));
a hospital with not more than 50 beds that was treated as being located in a rural area pursuant to section 1886(d)(8)(E); or

subparagraph.text: provides 24-hour emergency medical care and observation care that does not exceed an annual per patient average of 24 hours or more than 1 midnight;
does not provide any acute care inpatient beds and has protocols in place for the timely transfer of patients who require acute care inpatient services or other inpatient services;

provides for the transport of patients who require acute care inpatient services or other inpatient services from the rural emergency access center to a hospital or critical access hospital, either by the rural emergency access center’s ambulance service provider or through another ambulance service supplier;
has elected to be designated as a rural emergency access center;
has been licensed by, or received approval to operate as a qualified emergency medical center from, the State under paragraph (3); and
is certified by the Secretary under paragraph (4).

paragraph.text: The term rural emergency access center services means medical and other health services furnished by a rural emergency access center on an outpatient basis.
A facility may not operate as a rural emergency access center unless the facility—

subparagraph.text: is located in a State that provides for the licensing of emergency medical centers under State or applicable local law; and

clause.text: is licensed pursuant to such law; or
is approved by the agency of such State or locality responsible for licensing hospitals, as meeting the standards established for such licensing.

paragraph.text: The Secretary shall certify a facility as a rural emergency access center if the facility—

subparagraph.text: meets the criteria for rural emergency access center described in subparagraphs (A) through (F) of paragraph (1);
has in effect a transfer agreement with a level I or level II trauma center; and
meets such staff training and certification requirements as the Secretary may require.

paragraph.header: Payment for rural emergency access center services

subparagraph.text: Section 1833(a) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395l(a)) is amended—

clause.text: in paragraph (8), by striking and at the end;
in paragraph (9), by striking the period at the end and inserting ; and; and
by inserting after paragraph (9) the following new paragraph:

paragraph.text: in the case of rural emergency access center services and services provided by a rural emergency access center ambulance service provider or another ambulance service supplier to transport patients who require acute care inpatient services or other inpatient services from such rural emergency access center to a hospital or critical access hospital, the amounts described in section 1834(x).

subparagraph.text: Section 1834 of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395m) is amended by adding at the end the following subsection:

subsection.header: Payment rules relating to rural emergency access centers

paragraph.header: Payment for rural emergency access center outpatient services
paragraph.text: The amount of payment for rural emergency access center services of a rural emergency access center is determined as follows:

subparagraph.text: With respect to facility services (other than services for which payment is made under subparagraph (B)), the sum of the following:

clause.text: The amount of payment that would otherwise apply under section 1833(t) for covered OPD services (as defined in section 1833(t)(1)(B) (other than clause (ii) of such section)).

An additional facility payment in an amount determined appropriate by the Secretary that takes into account the low volume of services provided by such center and the low number of individuals served by such center.

subparagraph.text: With respect to professional services, the amount of payment that would otherwise be made under this part (other than under section 1833(t)(21)) for such services.

paragraph.text: The payment amount for ambulance services provided by a rural emergency access center ambulance service provider or another ambulance service supplier to transport patients who require acute care inpatient services or other inpatient services from such rural emergency access center to a hospital or critical access hospital is equal to the sum of—

subparagraph.text: the amount that would otherwise be paid for such ambulance services under section 1834(l); and
an additional amount determined appropriate by the Secretary.

subsection.text: Section 1866(a)(1) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395cc(a)(1)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in subparagraph (X), by striking at the end and;
in subparagraph (Y), by striking at the end the period and inserting , and; and
by inserting after subparagraph (Y) the following new subparagraph:

subparagraph.text: in the case of a rural emergency access center, to meet requirements applicable to critical access hospitals under this title, other than—

clause.text: requirements relating to a Medicare rural hospital flexibility program under section 1820(c), including state designation of a facility as a critical access hospital and criteria for such designation under paragraph (2) of such section;
requirements relating to critical access hospitals and rural health networks under section 1820(d);
certification by the Secretary as a critical access hospital under section 1820(e);
requirements relating to the provision of inpatient hospital services or acute care beds by a hospital or critical access hospital under this section, including under—

subclause.text: paragraph (1)(G) of this subsection (relating to certain payment restrictions for inpatient hospital services); and
paragraph (1)(T) of this subsection (relating to data submission requirements for inpatient hospital services for purposes of the low-volume adjustment); and

clause.text: such others provisions of law or regulation, including provisions under Part B and Part E, as the Secretary may specify.

subsection.text: Section 1834(m)(4)(C)(ii) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395m(m)(4)(C)(ii)) is amended by adding at the end the following new subclause:

subclause.text: A rural emergency access center (as defined in section 1861(kkk)(1)).

subsection.text: Section 1861(u) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395x(u)) is amended by inserting rural emergency access center, after critical access hospital,.
Section 340B(a)(4) of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 256b(a)(4)) is amended by adding at the end the following new subparagraph:

subparagraph.text: A rural emergency access center (as defined in section 1861(kkk)(1) of the Social Security Act) and that meets the requirements of subparagraph (L)(i).
